# Emmanuel Echavarria

> Official website of Emmanuel Echavarria, a Mexican director and cinematographer working across fashion, film and visual storytelling.

## Website

- https://itsemmanuelec.com/

## About

Emmanuel Echavarria is a Mexican director and cinematographer working across fashion, film and visual storytelling.

He began his career as talent, working alongside established directors and on productions for internationally recognized brands. While studying, he was introduced to production and gradually moved behind the camera, developing his practice in directing and cinematography.

His work combines directing, cinematography and production, with a focus on visual atmosphere, movement, light and cinematic composition.

He has worked on productions across Mexico, the United States, Europe and Asia.

## Work

The portfolio includes commercial work, music videos, film and production projects.
